name: Firefighters
oneLiner: Ranked the single most AI-proof occupation in a study of O*NET physical abilities.
why: Stamina, static strength, reaction time, spatial orientation, danger detection
Someone has to be accountable when the decision kills or saves
The environment changes faster than any specification can describe
threats: Dispatch, mapping and paperwork are already being automated around the role
Public-sector pay and staffing are political, not technological, risks

claims.text: First on a ranking of occupations that rely most on six O*NET abilities: stamina, static strength, reaction time, spatial orientation, time sharing and problem sensitivity.
The distinguishing feature is that the work requires recognising problems, interpreting changing conditions, deciding under unpredictable conditions — and that a wrong call injures someone.
